operations.details: Verified official OGC MUDDI standard page.
Underground-domain data separated from surface bare-earth DTM.
Subsurface depth attributes not promoted to parcel terrain elevation.
MUDDI model requires independent surface-measurement evidence.
Verified official OGC CDB Version 2 Core standard.
CDB datastore compliance separated from authoritative terrain survey status.
Simulation-oriented terrain content not promoted to measured parcel height.
CDB structure alone rejected as vertical datum or uncertainty proof.
MUDDI and CDB2 URLs confirmed absent from prior source registry.
No subsurface or simulation value substituted for parcel result.
Canonical manifest untouched; serial publisher required.
